body:
The quality of results produced by any system depends on the quality of awareness from which the people in the system operate. (Otto Scharmer)

 This week’s gathering (Children, Youth, and a New Kind of Christianity) has been an awareness-enhancer for all of us participating … Scharmer’s words help crystallize why I write, and how writing makes a difference.
